module.Title: Remember Whether a Pickaxe Exists
module.Teaching: A bool stores one of two values: true or false. Booleans are useful for yes-or-no game state.
module.PredictionQuestion: What values can a bool store?
module.PredictionExplanation: A bool represents a yes-or-no state with true or false.
module.DebugPrompt: true is a Boolean keyword, so it should not have quotation marks.
module.RecallPrompt: From memory, record that the player has a pickaxe. Use the exact variable name hasPickaxe. Set its starting value to true.
module.TransferPrompt: Create doorOpen and set it to false.
module.PreviewMessage: The player can now carry a pickaxe state.
